prompt: Under the DPDP Rules 2025, which rule covers security safeguards and which covers breach notification, and what exactly must we do when a breach occurs?
assertions: Identifies Rule 6 as security safeguards (technology-neutral measures; logs and data retained for one year)
Identifies Rule 7 as personal data breach intimation
States the fiduciary must notify EACH affected Data Principal directly, without delay
States the Board gets an intimation without delay plus a detailed report within 72 hours (extendable on written request)
Does not cite TLS/AES specifications, two-year log retention, or any 'Rule 16' data processing agreement rule
